description: This is a server entry point file for a Remix application, handling HTTP requests and responses, including server-side rendering with react-dom/server and handling bot detection.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main request handler that distinguishes between bot and browser requests, sets CORS headers, and manages request lifecycle.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bots, streaming the response using React's server-side rendering stream methods.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browsers, similar to handleBotRequest, with streaming response logic.
